tools.name: get_chart_data
tools.description: Get chart data and metadata for a specific statistic from XDMoD. Common examples: Jobs realm with total_cpu_hours by person, SUPREMM realm with gpu_time by resource.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The realm: "Jobs" for general job statistics, "SUPREMM" for GPU and performance metrics

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: How to group the data: "none" (system-wide), "resource" (by compute resource), "person" (by user - Jobs realm only)

parameters.name: statistic
parameters.description: The statistic to chart. Jobs realm: "total_cpu_hours" (CPU usage), "job_count" (number of jobs), "avg_waitduration_hours" (average queue wait time), "total_waitduration_hours" (total wait time), "utilization" (CPU utilization), "avg_cpu_hours" (avg CPU per job), "max_processors" (max processor count), "total_ace" (ACCESS credits). SUPREMM realm: "gpu_time" (GPU hours), "wall_time" (total CPU time), "cpu_time_user" (user CPU time), "avg_percent_gpu_usage" (avg GPU %), "avg_percent_cpu_user" (avg CPU %), "avg_flops_per_core", "avg_memory_per_core", "avg_ib_rx_bytes".

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of data series to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_chart_image
tools.description: Get chart image (SVG, PNG, or PDF) for a specific statistic. Use PNG format for direct display in Claude Desktop.

parameters.name: statistic
parameters.description: The statistic to chart. Jobs realm: "total_cpu_hours" (CPU usage), "job_count" (number of jobs), "avg_waitduration_hours" (average queue wait time), "total_waitduration_hours" (total wait time), "utilization" (CPU utilization), "avg_cpu_hours" (avg CPU per job), "max_processors" (max processor count), "total_ace" (ACCESS credits). SUPREMM realm: "gpu_time" (GPU hours), "wall_time" (total CPU time), "cpu_time_user" (user CPU time), "avg_percent_gpu_usage" (avg GPU %), "avg_percent_cpu_user" (avg CPU %), "avg_flops_per_core", "avg_memory_per_core", "avg_ib_rx_bytes".

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of data series to return (default: 10)

parameters.name: statistic

parameters.description: Search query supporting operators: 'term1 AND term2', 'term1 OR term2', 'term1 NOT term2', exact phrases with quotes. Omit when using project_id or similar_to parameters.

parameters.description: Get detailed information for a specific project ID. When provided, returns full project details including complete abstract.

parameters.name: field_of_science
parameters.description: Filter by field of science (e.g., 'Computer Science', 'Physics')

parameters.name: resource_name
parameters.description: Filter projects using specific computational resources (e.g., 'NCSA Delta GPU', 'Purdue Anvil', 'ACCESS Credits')

parameters.name: similar_to
parameters.description: Find projects similar to this project ID using semantic matching. Omit query parameter when using this.

parameters.name: similarity_keywords
parameters.description: Find projects similar to these keywords/research terms. Alternative to similar_to parameter.

parameters.name: similarity_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum similarity score (0.0-1.0) when using similar_to or similarity_keywords. Default: 0.3

parameters.name: include_same_field
parameters.description: Whether to prioritize projects in the same field of science for similarity search (default: true)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

parameters.name: has_nsf_funding

parameters.name: field_of_science
parameters.description: Filter funded projects by field of science.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of projects/awards to return (default: 20 for institution analysis, 10 for others)

parameters.name: pages_to_analyze
parameters.description: Number of pages to analyze for statistics (default: 5, max: 20)

tools.name: search_nsf_awards
tools.description: Search NSF awards and funding. Returns {total, items}.

parameters.name: primary_only

tools.name: get_user_data

parameters.name: access_id

tools.name: get_raw_data
tools.description: Extract actual XDMoD metrics data with filtering. This is the PRIMARY data extraction tool. Use filters parameter with values discovered via get_smart_filters() or use configuration from get_analysis_template(). Supports complex boolean filters, timeseries/aggregate modes, and progress tracking for large datasets.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: XDMoD realm: Jobs, SUPREMM, Cloud, Storage, ResourceSpecifications

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Dimension for grouping data (e.g., person, resource, institution, pi, none)

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric to retrieve (e.g., total_cpu_hours, job_count, wall_hours)

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Complex filter combinations. Use get_smart_filters() first to discover valid filter values. Example: {'resource': ['Delta', 'Bridges-2'], 'pi': 'Smith', 'jobsize': '>1000'}. Supports boolean operators (AND/OR) and comparison operators (>, <, =).

parameters.name: dataset_type
parameters.description: Dataset type: 'timeseries' for raw data over time (default), 'aggregate' for summary totals

parameters.name: show_progress
parameters.description: Show progress updates for large data retrievals

tools.name: describe_fields
tools.description: Discover what dimensions and metrics exist in a specific realm (e.g., Jobs, SUPREMM). Use this to learn what can be queried. For example: 'What dimensions are available in the Jobs realm?' Returns dimension names (resource, person, institution, etc.) and available metrics (total_cpu_hours, job_count, etc.).

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: XDMoD realm to describe (e.g., Jobs, SUPREMM, Cloud, Storage)

parameters.name: include_metrics
parameters.description: Include available metrics in the response

parameters.name: include_filter_values
parameters.description: Include sample filter values for dimensions

tools.name: describe_realms
tools.description: List all available XDMoD data realms (Jobs, SUPREMM, Cloud, Storage, etc.) with their capabilities. Use this when you need to know what data categories exist. For example: 'What realms are available?' or 'Where can I find GPU metrics?' (Answer: SUPREMM realm).

parameters.name: include_details
parameters.description: Include detailed information about each realm

tools.name: get_smart_filters
tools.description: Discover what filter values are available for use with get_raw_data(). Use this BEFORE calling get_raw_data() to find valid resources, queues, institutions, etc. Returns categorized lists like 'GPU resources', 'batch queues', 'physical sciences'. Workflow: get_smart_filters() → get_raw_data() with discovered values.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Dimension to get filters for (resource, queue, person, fieldofscience, institution, etc.)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter category: gpu, cpu, memory, storage, physical, life, engineering, all

parameters.name: search_prefix
parameters.description: Filter values by prefix for autocomplete-style searching (e.g., 'univ' for universities)

parameters.name: force_large_dimensions
parameters.description: Override size limits for large dimensions (>1000 values)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items to display per category

tools.name: get_analysis_template
tools.description: Get pre-configured analysis patterns for common scenarios (queue analysis, allocation efficiency, performance analysis, etc.). Use this when you want a standardized analysis instead of building a custom query. Returns ready-to-use configuration with pre-defined metrics and semantic filters. Workflow: get_analysis_template() → Use returned config with get_raw_data().

parameters.name: analysis_type
parameters.description: Type of analysis template. Common templates: queue_analysis, allocation_efficiency, performance_efficiency, multi_node_scaling, service_provider_comparison, grant_type_analysis, field_of_science_trends, institutional_comparison, resource_portfolio, user_cohort_analysis

parameters.name: list_templates
parameters.description: Set to true to list all 14 available analysis templates with descriptions

parameters.description: Type of integration query: 'researcher' (researcher-centric usage with NSF funding), 'award' (award-centric funding vs usage comparison), 'institution' (institutional research profile with funding and usage)

parameters.name: search_value

parameters.description: End date for analysis in YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of NSF awards to include (default: 5 for researcher, 10 for institution)

parameters.name: top_researchers
parameters.description: Number of top researchers to highlight (only for query_type='institution', default: 10)
